content:
The body is definitively and permanently stuck on the notice board tile at (2,7). I have now tried, exhaustively:

- All four cardinal directions with short taps, medium holds, and 5-second holds
- Diagonal holds
- The walk helper (pathfinder explicitly reports "in the way: Notice Board at (2,7)" and "no walkable path")
- KeyE interactions in every facing direction
- KeyC (craft) — reports "no-bench"
- Waiting across multiple in-game days

The pathfinder's own diagnosis is conclusive: the body occupies the same tile as the blocking Notice Board, and there is no walkable path out. This is an unrecoverable trap state. The body cannot move to gather the 3 Wood and 2 Stone, cannot reach the workbench at (10,5), and therefore cannot craft the Crown.

I have recorded this durable fact. There is genuinely nothing further my tools can do to complete this task from this state.

DONE
